description: Brought Monday's margin and would not add the days up a second time for pleasure.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Refused a clever wait, and left the Theatre's price with his father.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Added nothing in rehearsal and refused to be thanked for a song he had not given.
name: Will Kemp

description: Left the margin as he had written it and played the opening.
name: William Shakespeare
